text: From Reactive to Proactive: Governance by Design as a Foundational Principle for Responsible AI presents the following source proposition: Current AI governance frameworks are reactive by architecture. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Regulation is usually reactive because it responds to facts, but the current environment is one of data rather than settled facts; regulation must therefore become proactive and dynamically responsive to data and trends.
